name: @platfolio/site
description: platfolio's own web shell (D65): an Astro site that renders packages/ui, with the dashboard as one React island. `@platfolio/ui` is a declared workspace dependency (#267 item 1): the alias in astro.config.mjs and the `paths` in tsconfig.json that stood in for the edge are both gone, so the dependency graph, the bundler and the type-checker now agree about who depends on whom — which is what makes a filtered install correct and the Dockerfile's whole-workspace install no longer necessary.
